copy.headline: Arlington police searching for Steven Brock, wanted for injury to elderly with intent of bodily injury
copy.caption:
Arlington police are looking for Steven Brock, wanted for injury to elderly with intent of bodily injury. Crime Stoppers is offering up to $2,000 for information leading to an arrest.

Call 817-469-TIPS (8477) or submit a tip at 469tips.com. You stay anonymous.
